title: Fetch URLs with bounded concurrency, results in order
task: Implement `fetch.All(urls []string, limit int, get Getter) []Result` that fetches every URL through `Getter` with at most `limit` in flight at once and returns results in input order, each carrying the body or the error for that URL. Tests use a fake getter that records the peak number of concurrent calls, and must be deterministic. Keep the concurrency plumbing apart from the per-URL work.
